LanguageData.MF_StudioDecorateHelp: Choose backdrop artwork and place seat and light blueprints.
LanguageData.MF_StudioSetHelp: Family uses a three-place sofa; Garden a three-place bench; Birthday one armchair. Each set adds two lights at the sides. Participants use seats before standing rows. Artwork and furniture can be selected separately.
LanguageData.MF_StudioSetCost: Furniture needs materials and construction. Existing furniture is not moved or replaced. Lights require power. Automatic lights stay on from gathering to dismissal. Photographs preserve the studio lighting.
LanguageData.MF_StudioLightHelp: Connects to the nearest studio in the same room, within ten cells. Automatic lights stay on while gathering and holding for retakes, then turn off on dismissal.
